text:
Methanol, CH3OH, is a member of the homologous series of alcohols.
What is the formula of the alcohol in the same homologous series which contains three carbon
atoms?
A
C3H5OH
B
C3H6OH
C
C3H7OH
D
C3H8OH
subject: Chemistry
